entries.basis: The monograph's own two-page contents, now held as part of a six-page front-matter scan, confirms a linguistic study organized around East Aramaic dialects, aims and material, phonology, and morphology, followed by conclusions, bibliography, and abbreviations. Wajsberg's complete review supplies additional scope context. The monograph chapters remain unheld.
